name: Frelia
source:
Frelia is the Administrator of the Second Tower of Ar tonelico; and also the one that created and maintains its existence. She is called the "Goddess" by the people of Metafalss, and resides in the satellite Sol Marta, located in the highest reaches of the atmosphere. From there, she was supposed to overlook the region of Metafalss, and make sure that nothing out of normal ever happened there. Her main characteristics are her wings and hairstyle, which give her the appearance of a fairy, and her shy personality.

[From [url=http://artonelico.wikia.com/wiki/Frelia]Ar Tonelico Wiki[/url]]
